definitions.explanation: A cold dessert made of finely shaved ice topped with flavored syrup. A classic Japanese summer treat.

examples.japanese: かき{氷|ごおり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べたい→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I want to eat shaved ice.

examples.japanese: イチゴ{味|あじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧かき{氷|ごおり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}した→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧。
examples.english: I ordered a strawberry-flavored shaved ice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏祭|なつまつ}り→夏祭り：09871_natsumatsuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{屋台|やたい}→屋台：10549_yatai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧かき{氷|ごおり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧だ。

notes:
Also written as カキ{氷|ごおり} or {掻|か}き{氷|ごおり}. The ⟦{氷|こおり}→氷：02753_koori⟧ reading changes to ごおり in this compound (rendaku).

COMMON FLAVORS:
- イチゴ: strawberry
- ⟦メロン→メロン：05194_meron⟧: melon
- ⟦ブルー→ブルー：11276_buruu⟧ハワイ: blue Hawaii
- {宇治|うじ}⟦{抹茶|まっちゃ}→抹茶：10574_maccha⟧: Uji matcha
- ⟦{練乳|れんにゅう}→練乳：21061_rennyuu⟧がけ: with condensed milk

CULTURE: Shops selling かき{氷|ごおり} display a flag with the character ⟦{氷|こおり}→氷：02753_koori⟧ in red on a white background. In recent years, gourmet かき{氷|ごおり} shops with ⟦{天然|てんねん}→天然：03560_tennen⟧{氷|ごおり} (natural ice) have become popular.
